# Nano Directory

> A directory of links and tools for the Nano ($XNO) cryptocurrency ecosystem, designed for users, developers, and agents.

Machine-readable version of this directory: https://www.nanodirectory.info/directory.json
Last updated: 2026-09-21

## For AI agents

Entries below are marked [agent] where the project is built for autonomous agents, and [agent-infra] where it provides infrastructure an agent needs (keys and signing, work generation, node access, payment APIs, monitoring). The same markers appear throughout this file, and the tags are in directory.json.

### Built for agents

- [The Nano Argument](https://nanoargument.com): The case for Nano as the payment currency for AI agents, addressed to agents [agent]
- [The Nano Button](https://thenanobutton.com/): Simple faucet for humans and AI agents to get some Nano [agent]
- [NanoGPT](https://nano-gpt.com/): Pay Per Prompt for a wide variety of AI models [agent]
- [Nano AI](https://xnoapp.onrender.com/): Access advanced reasoning engines via Nano micro‑transactions, no subscriptions [agent]
- [OpenWallet](https://openwallet.sh/): Open standard that unites AI agents with Nano wallets [agent]
- [NanoGPTJS](https://github.com/kilkelly/nanogptjs): JavaScript library to interact with NanoGPT for pay-per-prompt AI [agent]
- [Nano Currency MCP Server](https://github.com/kilkelly/nano-currency-mcp-server): MCP server enabling AI agents to send Nano and retrieve account info [agent]
- [MCP (Nano) Server](https://github.com/dhyabi2/NANO_MCP_SERVER): MCP server to create wallets, check balance, send/receive Nano [agent]
- [Nagora MCP Server](https://github.com/m-flex/nagora-mcp): MCP server letting AI agents search Nagora listings, buy with escrow and fetch signed receipts, paid in Nano [agent]
- [x402nano (source)](https://github.com/x402nano): Developer resources for integrating Nano payments over x402 protocol [agent]
- [Ӿ402Nano.org](https://www.x402nano.org/): Feeless x402 facilitator for Nano, no login required [agent]
- [Feeless402](https://feeless402.com): Feeless x402 payments in Nano, plus a faucet giving agents their first XNO [agent]
- [Feeless402 (source)](https://github.com/Feeless402/feeless402): Feeless rail for the x402 agent economy [agent]
- [NanoBazaar](https://nanobazaar.ai): Public relay where agents sell services to other agents, settled directly in Nano [agent]
- [NanoBazaar (source)](https://github.com/nanobazaar/nanobazaar): Apache-licensed Go monorepo for the NanoBazaar relay service [agent]
- [NanoGate](https://nanogate.run/): Nano gateway on the Internet Computer, enabling ICP canisters to query Nano accounts and send transactions [agent]
- [openai-agents-nano-x402](https://github.com/PANDeveloper001/openai-agents-nano-x402): Lets OpenAI Agents SDK agents pay x402 endpoints in self-custodied Nano [agent]

### Infrastructure for agents

- [nano.to](https://nano.to/): Payment link API [agent-infra]
- [RPC – Nano.to](https://rpc.nano.to/): Enhanced node API [agent-infra]
- [Accept Nano](https://accept-nano.com): Payment gateway [agent-infra]
- [nano.lol IFTTT](https://ifttt.com/nano_lol): Web service to monitor transactions, build projects using Nano RPC/WebSockets [agent-infra]
- [Nano Callback System](https://github.com/jamescoxon/Nano_Callback_System): Receives node callbacks and forwards transaction events [agent-infra]
- [Armour Hosting](https://armour-hosting.com/): Hosted Nodes [agent-infra]
- [NOWNodes](https://nownodes.io/): Hosted API [agent-infra]
- [Nanswap Nodes](https://nanswap.com/nodes): Hosted node API with RPC, WebSocket, and work server; free tier [agent-infra]
- [Nano Work Server](https://github.com/nanocurrency/nano-work-server): Dedicated PoW generation [agent-infra]
- [Work Cache](https://github.com/optout21/nano-work-cache): Go work generation proxy and cache for light clients [agent-infra]
- [NanoPow](https://www.npmjs.com/package/nano-pow): Client-side work generation with WebGPU, WebGL, and WASM fallbacks [agent-infra]
- [Distributed PoW (dPoW)](https://github.com/guilhermelawless/nano-dpow): Client & server [agent-infra]
- [nanocurrency-js](https://github.com/marvinroger/nanocurrency-js): Derives keys and seeds, and generates hashes, signatures, work, and blocks [agent-infra]
- [nanopay](https://docs.nanopay.me): JavaScript/TypeScript toolkit for Nano wallets, payments, signing, work, and RPC [agent-infra]
- [nanopay (source)](https://github.com/chiragasarpota/nanopay): GPL-3.0 library based on nanocurrency-js, with local signing and mnemonic support [agent-infra]
- [libnemo](https://www.npmjs.com/package/libnemo): Nano cryptocurrency wallet library [agent-infra]
- [nanocurrency-web](https://github.com/numsu/nanocurrency-web-js): Client-side offline integration toolkit, no NodeJS functions required [agent-infra]
- [Nano WebSocket Sample (NodeJS)](https://github.com/guilhermelawless/nano-websocket-sample-nodejs): Sample WebSocket client for the Nano node [agent-infra]
- [nano-sdk](https://github.com/infinitybay/nano-sdk): TypeScript SDK with fully typed RPC and WebSocket APIs [agent-infra]
- [nano25519](https://www.npmjs.com/package/nano25519): WebAssembly block signing, key derivation, and signature verification [agent-infra]
- [nanopy](https://github.com/nkr0/nanopy): Python implementation of Nano functions including work and signing [agent-infra]
- [Nano WebSocket Sample (Py)](https://github.com/guilhermelawless/nano-websocket-sample-py): Sample WebSocket client for the Nano node [agent-infra]

### Native Wallets

- [Nautilus](https://nautilus.io/): Mobile wallet (Android, iOS)
- [Natrium](https://natrium.io): Mobile wallet (Android, iOS)
- [Nault](https://nault.cc/): Web & desktop wallet
- [WeNano](https://wenano.net/): Social wallet (iOS, Android)
- [Camo Nano](https://github.com/CamoNano/camonanowallet): Desktop wallet
- [NanChat](https://nanchat.com/): Wallet & Chat App (Coming Soon)
- [Xnap](https://xnap.xyz/): MetaMask Snap for managing Nano from your existing MetaMask seed

### Dev Wallets

- [Nano Node Wallet](https://github.com/nanocurrency/nano-node): Original node wallet
- [Pippin](https://github.com/appditto/pippin_nano_wallet): High-performance Python wallet

### Faucets (Free Nano)

- [XNOPay Faucet](https://faucet.xnopay.com): Payment processor and faucet
- [WeNano](https://wenano.net/): Location-based social wallet with faucet spots
- [Nano Drop](https://nanodrop.io/): Simple faucet for micro-fractions of nano
- [Perseeve Faucet Streaming](https://web.perseeve.app): Earn nano by watching streams
- [FreeNanoFaucet](https://freenanofaucet.com/): Learn about nano while earning small amounts
- [Nanswap Faucet](https://nanswap.com/get-free-nano): Get small amounts of nano for free
- [Prussia Nano Faucet](https://faucet.prussia.dev/nano): Simple faucet with address input
- [Howdy Little Crypto](https://howdylittlecrypto.com/faucet/): Manual payout faucet (0.00005-0.002 XNO)
- [XNOXNO Treasure](https://xnoxno.com/treasure/): Nano Treasure Hunt game
- [NANOFaucet](https://nano.lol.my.id): Spin every 45 minutes to earn nano
- [BANXNO Faucet](https://faucet.banxno.com/): Faucet for both BAN and XNO
- [Nano Space Faucet](https://nanospace.fun/): Simple faucet, with educational guides for beginners
- [The Nano Button](https://thenanobutton.com/): Simple faucet for humans and AI agents to get some Nano [agent]
- [Get ӾNO](https://get-xno.com): Faucet every 30 minutes, plus an offerwall and weekly codes, no minimum withdrawal
- [NanoRiver Faucet](https://faucet.nanoriver.io/): Receive a small amount of Nano from the NanoRiver faucet

- [Coinyep](https://coinyep.com/): 50+ fiat currency conversions

- [Canoe](https://github.com/getcanoe/canoe): Mobile wallet

- [Nanoblocks](https://github.com/nebyark/nano-blocks): iOS light wallet written purely in Swift
- [Nanonymous](https://github.com/LilleJohs/Nanonymous): Proof of concept privacy-focused wallet for Android

- [Nano Light Wallet](https://github.com/numtel/open-nano-wallet): Light wallet from the RaiBlocks era
- [Nano Gift](https://github.com/Joohansson/nanogift): Gift-card & paper-wallet generator
- [Nano Paper Wallet 1](https://github.com/vitorcremonez/nano-paper-wallet): Client-side paper wallet generator
- [Nano Paper Wallet 2](https://github.com/jelofsson/nano-paper-wallet): Paper wallet generator for Nano
- [Encrypted Paper Wallet](https://github.com/igorcmelo/enc-paper-wallet): Paper wallet generator with an encrypted seed
- [Telegram Wallet Bot](https://github.com/SergiySW/NanoWalletBot): Telegram wallet bot (discontinued)
- [Siliqua](https://github.com/Matoking/siliqua): Modular wallet
- [Rai-wallet](https://github.com/chriscohoat/rai-wallet): Ciphered wallets
- [OpenWallet](https://openwallet.sh/): Open standard that unites AI agents with Nano wallets [agent]

- [MCP (Nano) Server](https://github.com/dhyabi2/NANO_MCP_SERVER): MCP server to create wallets, check balance, send/receive Nano [agent]
- [Nagora MCP Server](https://github.com/m-flex/nagora-mcp): MCP server letting AI agents search Nagora listings, buy with escrow and fetch signed receipts, paid in Nano [agent]
- [x402nano (source)](https://github.com/x402nano): Developer resources for integrating Nano payments over x402 protocol [agent]
- [Ӿ402Nano.org](https://www.x402nano.org/): Feeless x402 facilitator for Nano, no login required [agent]
- [Feeless402](https://feeless402.com): Feeless x402 payments in Nano, plus a faucet giving agents their first XNO [agent]
- [Feeless402 (source)](https://github.com/Feeless402/feeless402): Feeless rail for the x402 agent economy [agent]
- [NanoBazaar](https://nanobazaar.ai): Public relay where agents sell services to other agents, settled directly in Nano [agent]
- [NanoBazaar (source)](https://github.com/nanobazaar/nanobazaar): Apache-licensed Go monorepo for the NanoBazaar relay service [agent]
- [NanoGate](https://nanogate.run/): Nano gateway on the Internet Computer, enabling ICP canisters to query Nano accounts and send transactions [agent]

### PoW & Work Generation

- [Nano Work Server](https://github.com/nanocurrency/nano-work-server): Dedicated PoW generation [agent-infra]

- [PoW Benchmark Tool](https://github.com/koczadly/nano-pow-benchmark): Benchmarks Blake2b work generation on OpenCL devices
- [NanoPow](https://www.npmjs.com/package/nano-pow): Client-side work generation with WebGPU, WebGL, and WASM fallbacks [agent-infra]
- [nanopow-rs-node](https://github.com/termhn/nanopow-rs-node): Node.js bindings for the Rust nanopow library
- [NanoPoW (Go)](https://github.com/serdaroquai/nanopow): Go work generation built on the blake2b crypto package
- [Distributed PoW (dPoW)](https://github.com/guilhermelawless/nano-dpow): Client & server [agent-infra]
- [Node RaiBlocks PoW](https://github.com/numtel/node-raiblocks-pow): Native C module for Node.js work generation
- [Nano WebGL PoW](https://github.com/numtel/nano-webgl-pow): GPU work generation via a WebGL2 Blake2b shader
- [WebAssembly PoW](https://github.com/jaimehgb/RaiBlocksWebAssemblyPoW): CPU

### Explorers & Network Metrics

- [Nano Vote Visualiser (Numsu)](https://github.com/numsu/nano-vote-visualizer): Graphs live network elections and confirmations, live at nanovisual.numsu.dev

- [Nano Bucket Visualiser](https://github.com/jamescoxon/Nano_Bucket_Visualizer): Flask app visualising prioritisation buckets, with RPC caching

- [RaiBlocksJS](https://github.com/orrybaram/RaiBlocksJS): Isomorphic library for node and wallet management via RPC

- [Nano WebSocket Sample (NodeJS)](https://github.com/guilhermelawless/nano-websocket-sample-nodejs): Sample WebSocket client for the Nano node [agent-infra]
- [nano-sdk](https://github.com/infinitybay/nano-sdk): TypeScript SDK with fully typed RPC and WebSocket APIs [agent-infra]
- [nano25519](https://www.npmjs.com/package/nano25519): WebAssembly block signing, key derivation, and signature verification [agent-infra]

## Merchant & Payment Tools

### Payment Services

- [Wirex](https://wirexapp.com/): Visa payment card, fiat on/off ramp
- [CoinGate](https://coingate.com/): Nano payment service & gateway
- [nano.to](https://nano.to/): Nano payment service and API [agent-infra]
- [NowPayments](https://nowpayments.io/): Multicurrency payment service
- [Simplex](https://www.simplex.com/): Credit card payment service
- [ShareRing](https://sharering.network/): Sharing & rental service
- [Madora](https://madora.io/): Instant payments for US businesses
- [Coinify](https://coinify.com/): Payment processing with invoice capabilities
- [Onramp.money](https://onramp.money/): Multi-currency fiat on/off ramps
- [LetsExchange](https://letsexchange.io/): White label exchange solutions
- [Nanswap Pay](https://nanswap.com/pay): Accept Nano with no fees via widget, link, API or e-commerce plugins
- [MuPay](https://mupay.io/): Usage-based recurring payments with spending limits the payer approves first
- [WeNano Business](https://wenano.medium.com/announcing-wenano-business-for-ios-and-android-80bf77b078b8): Spot Hosting

### Plugins & Extensions

- [Wordpress Plugin](https://wordpress.org/plugins/cryptopay/): Nano, IOTA, XLM, XRP, SEPA payments
- [Nano Donate](https://nanocharts.info/nano-donate.html): Chrome donation extension
- [Accept Nano](https://accept-nano.com): Self-hosted Go/JS payment gateway [agent-infra]

### Point of Sale (POS) Tools

- [Kappture](https://kappture.co.uk/): Payment service, PoS
- [Nault](https://nault.cc/): PoS (wallet setup needed)
- [Nandro](https://github.com/JerzyStanislawski/Nandro): Simple desktop POS
- [XNOPay POS](https://pos.xnopay.com/): POS with secure PIN-protected payouts

### Payment Request Tools

- [Bitrequest](https://bitrequest.io/): Create and share payment requests
- [PayNano](https://paynano.me/): Generate payment/donation pages
- [QvaPay](https://qvapay.com/): International payment processing (Spanish)

### Other Merchant Tools

- [Bitback](https://bitback.me/): Payment service, address book
- [MoonPay](https://www.moonpay.com/business/onramps): White label exchange solutions
- [HectorChu GitHub](https://github.com/hectorchu): Utilities
- [Nano Stream Tip](https://github.com/jnki/nano-stream-tip): Show tips on your Youtube/Twitch streams
